title: Background Agent Partial Result Preservation
description: When a background agent is killed or interrupted mid-task, its partial results are now preserved in the conversation context instead of being lost. Previously, killing a background agent discarded all in-progress work. Now, work completed before the kill is recoverable, enabling checkpoint-resume patterns. Complements the Autonomous Subagent Resume feature (v2.1.81) where the model decides to resume vs spawn fresh.
redundancy_check: NOVEL — registry has 'SendMessage Auto-Resume' and 'Autonomous Subagent Resume' but these are for resuming stopped agents. This is specifically about preserving partial output when an agent is killed (not stopped cleanly). Distinct use case: the agent cannot resume (killed), but its work-in-progress is recoverable from context.
notes: Particularly valuable for long-running discovery or integration agents that may be killed due to timeout, rate limit, or user interrupt. Means heartbeat automation loses less work on failure. No integration action required — this is automatic behavior. Documentation value: update helpers/playbooks/ with checkpoint pattern.
